stories.title: Trump, Putin and Xi to hold historic joint meeting in China
stories.summary: The White House says Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping will meet on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen next week, the first trilateral meeting of the US, Russian and Chinese leaders. Trump is expected to raise nuclear-arms reduction.

stories.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after air traffic control outage
stories.summary: The FAA lifted a nationwide ground stop about four to five hours after a communications outage at air traffic control centers halted US departures, disrupting thousands of flights. Officials say there is no evidence of a cyberattack.

stories.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Huang misled top lawyer about affair, Reuters reports
stories.summary: Reuters reported that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled the company's general counsel and chief marketing officer about his relationship with a Chinese businesswoman, adding to scrutiny following his resignation this week.

stories.title: Amazon drafts 'World Product Graph' to blunt AI shopping agents
stories.summary: An internal Amazon document reviewed by Reuters outlines 'World Product Graph,' a plan to compile data on virtually every product sold globally as a defense against third-party AI shopping agents like Meta's Muse. Coca-Cola and Bayer have signed on.

stories.title: Tesla opens Cybercab orders to select customers at $29,990
stories.summary: Tesla began inviting select customers to buy its steering-wheel-free Cybercab for $29,990 plus a $299/month autonomous-driving subscription, with personal-use deliveries starting as soon as next month in supported service areas.

stories.title: Ohio State rolls out recruiting visitors list for Northwestern game
stories.summary: Ohio State finalized its recruiting visitors list for Saturday's home game against Northwestern, headlined by blue-chip flip targets and 2027 running back commit Nigel Newkirk as the Buckeyes look to snap a two-game losing streak.

stories.title: Patricia's Ohio State defense faces adjustment calls before Northwestern
stories.summary: After surrendering 71 points across back-to-back losses to USC and Oregon, Matt Patricia's Ohio State defense needs fixes ahead of Saturday's home game against Northwestern, Lettermen Row's Birm writes.

stories.title: Wolff backs F1's plans to race in Middle East despite conflict
stories.summary: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff says F1 is right to press ahead with its Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds despite the US-Iran conflict prompting other series to cancel, and confirmed no staff would be forced to attend.

stories.title: F1 Commission to debate 'ADUO for teams' cost cap catch-up plan
stories.summary: Williams boss James Vowles has tabled a cost-cap catch-up mechanism dubbed 'ADUO for teams' that would let lower-ranked teams spend more to close the gap, with the proposal set for debate at Monday's F1 Commission meeting.

stories.title: FIA sets Nov 25 hearing for Audi's Monza appeal over Tsunoda
stories.summary: The FIA's International Court of Appeal will hear Audi's challenge to the Monza stewards' decision over Yuki Tsunoda's start procedure on November 25, a ruling that could strip Tsunoda of his 10th-place finish.

stories.title: Central Ohio high school football playoff scores (Week 3)
stories.summary: 10TV's First & 10 rounds up scores and highlights from Friday night's Week 3 regional playoff games across central Ohio as the postseason field narrows.
